statement: There is no plan-size control. The card for one person is labelled '1 Person' in its person line and '1 Year, 1 Person' / '2 Years, 1 Person' in its years line. The word 'Individual' from the task text never appears on the page, and the 'Single' string exists only inside a size-filter container the page ships with display:none.
supersedes: An earlier reconnaissance claim that a plan-size tab strip labelled Single/Couple/Family was operable; direct capture shows its container is display:none.

statement: Single-person pricing is $10.75/mo billed $129.00 annually, and $8.71/mo billed $209.00 every 2 years.

The 1-Person card renders its comparison price with an explicit inline style="visibility: hidden;" while the 2-People and Family cards carry an explicit style="visibility: visible;". The element is present in every case; only its visibility differs, because quantity one earns no quantity discount.

The plan grid defaults to the 2 Years term: every data-tag="1-Year" group carries display:none in the frozen capture. There is no default plan size, because size is not filtered - all four cards render side by side within the active term group.
Checkout collects first name, last name, email and one address, and no removal PII of any kind.
Checkout has no password field; the account password is set later from an emailed link.
Card data is collected only inside Stripe-hosted iframes.
The order summary needs a non-GET request: with non-GET aborted the whole summary renders null.
An unknown marketing path 301s to the trailing-slash form then answers 404 with headings 'Oops!' and “That page can’t be found.”.
An unknown application path answers HTTP 200 with a client-rendered 'Page not found'.
A no-match search answers 200 with heading 'Search', the echoed term in curly quotes, and no no-results message at all.
Sign-in shows Email and Password with only 'Continue with Google' as an identity provider, and has no remember-me control.
Password recovery guidance reads 'Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.' with submit 'Send reset link'.
'Create Account' leads to the paid checkout; /signup and /register do not exist on the application host.
The help centre is Zendesk on a separate host with categories 'Business Account Administration', 'Member Experience' and 'Frequently Asked Questions'; its ticket form is behind a managed challenge.
The desktop header Join Now target is the dead anchor #pricing, absent from both static HTML and the post-JS DOM of the home page.
The marketing pages load 35 distinct non-primary hosts; no payment, chat or video origin appears among them.
The subscriber dashboard, removal profile, reports, billing history and subscription controls were never observed.
The post-purchase removal profile - where age, phone, previous names and relatives are collected - is behind authentication and was never observed.
robots.txt allows named AI agents but disallows /*?s= for every agent.

The consumer plan grid carries a fourth card, 'Business', alongside 1 Person, 2 People and Family. It shows no price and no checkout link; its subtitle reads 'Protect your executives, critical employees or your entire organization'.
Each priced card's Start Protection link points directly at the checkout with the plan, term and quantity in the query: term=1|2 and qty=1|2|4, all against plan=prod_UJ03ZGKxM0BiGF.
